first-conversation.title: Jan and Mari say hello
first-conversation.bodyMarkdown:
**Jan:** Bonjou!

**Mari:** Bonjou!

**Jan:** Kijan ou ye?

**Mari:** Mwen byen, mèsi. E ou menm?

**Jan:** Mwen byen tou, mèsi.

**Mari:** Orevwa!

**Jan:** Orevwa!

Each turn responds naturally to the one before it.

conversation-flow.title: One turn leads to the next
conversation-flow.bodyMarkdown:
A useful first conversation can follow this flow:

1. greet
2. ask how the person is
3. answer
4. return the question
5. close politely

Do not memorize the lines as separate pieces. Listen for what the other person says, understand the turn, then respond naturally.

take-your-turn.title: Change the words, keep the conversation
take-your-turn.bodyMarkdown:
Listen to a second version.

The conversation structure is familiar, but some wording changes.

Listen for the flow of the conversation instead of memorizing one exact script.
